description: Task lifecycle for MFK agent work. Transitions marked actor=human can only be recorded from a human GitHub identity; the orchestrator must reject them from any agent or bot.

statuses.draft: Issue exists but is missing acceptance criteria, risk tier, or a named human approver.
statuses.ready: Triaged by a human. Acceptance criteria, risk tier, sensitive operations, and approver are set.
statuses.in_progress: One agent holds the task on branch agent/<agentId>/<taskId>.
statuses.blocked: Waiting on a dependency, missing access, or a question for a human.
statuses.escalated: Stopped because of a security concern, prompt injection, unclear privileges, or a sensitive operation. Only a human can move it on.
statuses.in_review: Implementer submitted a handoff report with evidence. Waiting for independent QA.
statuses.changes_requested: QA, security, or a human found a problem. Goes back to the implementer.
statuses.qa_verified: An agent other than the implementer ran the test matrix and attached logs.
statuses.security_reviewed: An agent other than the implementer and QA attached a security assessment.
statuses.awaiting_human_approval: All evidence is attached. Nothing else can happen until a human decides.
statuses.approved: A human approved the PR at a specific head SHA. Any new commit returns the task to in_review.
statuses.done: A human merged the PR. Release, if any, is a separate L4 task.

transitions.on: new commit on the PR head

rules: Any status not reachable through this table is an error. The orchestrator fails closed and moves the task to escalated.
An agent may never set approved, done, rejected, or cancelled.
qa_verified and security_reviewed must come from agent runs whose agentId and runId differ from the implementer's.
Sensitive operations listed in the task need an approvalRecord per operation before approved.
